_doc: Feature B - FR-09 Ma giam gia (Coupon) - du lieu cho tests/feature-b-coupon.spec.js
_nguon: Test case HW02 (Main_Report.md - FEATURE B: FR-09). Cot tcId truy nguoc ve dung test case do.

_mode.cart-flow: Them san pham vao gio bang UI that -> /cart -> /checkout -> ap ma. Chung minh suite chay duoc luong that, khong chi di cua sau.
_mode.total-set: Vao thang /checkout, dien o 'Tong tien thanh toan' bang row.total roi ap ma. Dung cho cac moc bien khong dung san pham seed nao dung duoc.
_mode.guest: Nhu total-set nhung KHONG dang nhap.
_mode.empty-code: Khong nhap ma - kiem nut 'Ap dung' phai bi disabled.
_mode.usage-seed: Dang ky user moi qua API, tieu truoc seedUsage luot coupon, roi ap ma.
_mode.ui-check: Chi kiem thuoc tinh DOM tinh, khong gui request.

_quy_uoc.expect: accept/reject THEO DAC TA FR-09, khong theo hanh vi hien tai cua SUT.
_quy_uoc.expectedStatus: Ma HTTP ma POST /api/apply-coupon PHAI tra theo dac ta. So cu the, hoac '4xx' khi dac ta chi doi 'bi tu choi' ma khong quy dinh ma nao, hoac null khi TC khong gui request.
_quy_uoc.expectedDiscount/expectedFinal: So tien THEO CONG THUC DAC TA (percent: floor(total * value/100); fixed: dung discount_value). null = TC nay khong kiem so tien.
_quy_uoc.vi_sao_mot_so_TC_khong_kiem_so_tien: R02/R03 kiem viec CHUAN HOA ma (in hoa / cat khoang trang). Neu gan them assertion so tien thi chung se Fail vi mot bug KHAC (B007 - cong thuc percent sai), lam nhoe muc dich cua TC. Cong thuc percent da co 3 TC rieng phu trach: DT-01, DT-08, BV-03.

title: Ap ma percent hop le tren gio hang that (SAVE10)
note: AirPods Pro 2 (san pham seed #4) = 6.000.000. Theo dac ta: giam 10% = 600.000, con 5.400.000. SUT dung cong thuc floor(total*(1-10)) nen ra so AM -54.000.000 va thanh tien 60.000.000. Vao gio bang nut 'Them vao gio' o trang chu (1 click) thay vi trang chi tiet (bi nuot click dau - bug cua FR-07, khong phai FR-09).

title: Ap ma fixed hop le (BIGBUY tren don 550.000)
note: Nhanh fixed tinh dung (discount_amount = discount_value), du kien Pass ca 3 assertion.

title: Ma khong ton tai
note: Chuoi kiem trong thong bao de khong dau de khong phu thuoc cach go dau tieng Viet; spec so khop bang chuan hoa bo dau o tang spec.

title: Ma da het han (EXPIRED)
note: EXPIRED co min_order 100.000 nen don 150.000 vuot nguong, dam bao request di toi nhanh kiem han su dung chu khong bi chan tu nguong toi thieu.

title: Khong nhap ma - nut Ap dung phai bi vo hieu hoa
note: SUT dat disabled={applyingCoupon || !couponCode.trim()} nen khong the bam - day la cach chan hop le theo dac ta.

title: Don chua du gia tri toi thieu (250.000 < 300.000)
note: Nam ro duoi nguong nen ca spec lan SUT deu tu choi - du kien Pass.

title: Khach chua dang nhap van ap duoc ma
technique: EP vung khong hop le (rang buoc C4)
note: Khi user_id = null, backend BO QUA toan bo nhanh kiem gioi han luot dung -> khach vang lai ap ma khong gioi han. Dac ta khong quy dinh ma loi cu the nen chi doi 4xx.

title: Kiem chung cong thuc percent tren don lon (30.000.000)
technique: EP vung hop le (gia tri lon)
note: iPhone 15 Pro Max (seed #1) = 30.000.000. Vao gio qua TRANG CHI TIET de suite phu ca hai duong dan; page object tu xu ly viec trang chi tiet nuot click dau tien.

title: Het luot dung ma (VIP100 da dung 2/2)
technique: EP vung khong hop le (gioi han luot)
note: Dung USER MOI cho moi lan chay: bang coupon_usage khong co API xoa, neu tieu luot tren test@eshop.com thi luot chay firefox/webkit sau do se thay het luot va TC BV-06 Fail vi moi truong chu khong phai vi bug.

title: O Tong tien thanh toan khong duoc sua tu do
technique: quan sat UI / toan ven du lieu
specRef: FR-09 tong tien tinh tu gio
note: Tong tien phai duoc tinh tu gio hang, khong phai o nhap tu do. TC nay BAT BUOC phai ton tai vi cac TC total-set dang LOI DUNG chinh o nay lam cong cu - neu khong co no, suite vua dung bug vua che mat bug do.

title: BVA - duoi nguong 1 dong (299.999 < 300.000)
note: Duoi nguong -> ca spec lan SUT deu tu choi.

title: BVA - dung bang nguong toi thieu (300.000)
note: Dac ta dung >= nen don dung bang nguong PHAI duoc chap nhan. SUT dung 'total_amount > min_order_amount' (thieu dau =) nen tu choi - loi off-by-one kinh dien, chi lo ra o dung moc nay.

title: BVA - tren nguong 1 dong (300.001)
note: Quyet dinh accept/reject dung (200), nhung so tien sai vi B007: floor(300001*10/100)=30000 theo dac ta, SUT tra so am.

title: BVA - duoi nguong BIGBUY 1 dong (499.999)
note: Lap lai phep kiem bien tren mot coupon KHAC de chac chan B006 la loi he thong chu khong phai loi rieng cua SAVE10.

title: BVA - dung bang nguong BIGBUY (500.000)
note: Cap doi cua BV-02 tren coupon fixed - xac nhan B006 xuat hien o CA HAI loai coupon, nen nguyen nhan nam o phep so sanh dung chung chu khong o nhanh tinh tien.

title: BVA - con luot dung (VIP100 da dung 1/2)
note: Bien duoi cua gioi han: da dung 1 lan, con 1 luot -> phai chap nhan. Cap doi voi DT-09 (da dung 2 -> tu choi).

title: Robust - ma go chu thuong (save10)
note: Client goi .toUpperCase() truoc khi gui. Khong kiem so tien o TC nay - xem _quy_uoc.vi_sao_mot_so_TC_khong_kiem_so_tien.

title: Robust - ma co khoang trang thua ('  SAVE10  ')
note: Client goi .trim() truoc khi gui. Khong kiem so tien - ly do nhu R02.
